title: Aquatic eDNA Sampling and Plant Community Metabarcoding with Nanopore Sequencing
author: Jordan Callahan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bc4wiyxe
materials: Next steps use materials from the DNeasy PowerWater kit. Check for: Solutions -- PW1, IRS, PW3, PW4, Ethanol, and EB. Collection tubes (2mL) Bead tubes (5mL) MB Spin columns + tubes Wipe down all closed reagent bottles with 50% bleach solution and place in a designated area of UV box.
Open MinKNOW software, install flowcell in MinION, and run flowcell check per manufacturer's instructions. Ensure that the flowcell has sufficient pores for sequencing and all other checks pass.

steps.title: Assemble drill pump and filter
steps.instruction: Attach hose ends to the drill pump, secure the pump to a wooden bracket with zip ties, lock the drill driver to the pump spindle, and connect a sterile 0.045 µm filter funnel assembly (Fisher Sci catalog #09 740 30K) to the “In” side of the pump, tightening the hose clamp while leaving the filter chamber cover on.

steps.title: Filter water sample
steps.instruction: Run the drill at ¾‑max speed (max = 1 700 RPM) for 15 min, stopping if the filter clogs or no water exits the outlet hose; refill the filter reservoir as needed; filtered volume will vary with microbial load and turbidity.

steps.title: Change gloves after filtering
steps.instruction: Switch to clean gloves and replace any gloves that have contacted anything other than the filter assembly or the sampled water.

steps.title: Retrieve and roll filter membrane
steps.instruction: Remove the upper portion of the filter assembly, then using two sterile forceps grasp opposite edges of the white filter membrane and roll it into a cylinder with the top side facing inward.

steps.title: Store filter membrane
steps.instruction: Place the rolled filter into a fresh 15 mL Falcon tube and either freeze at –20 °C or submerge in 200 proof molecular‑grade ethanol until DNA extraction.

steps.title: Label and record field data
steps.instruction: Label the Falcon tube with location, date, time, and sampling duration; record locality name, GPS coordinates, water temperature, sampling duration, and any observations in the field notebook.

steps.title: Mark sampling site
steps.instruction: If the site will be resampled, attach flagging tape labeled with sample date, locality name, and contact email.

steps.title: Decontaminate workspace
steps.instruction: Place all pipettes and tools inside the UV box, turn on the UV light to treat tools and workspace, and thereafter open tubes containing eDNA only inside this box.

steps.title: Insert filter into bead tube
steps.instruction: Using forceps sprayed with 50 % bleach and left for 2 min, transfer the filter membrane into a 5 mL PowerWater DNA bead tube (kit component).

steps.title: Add PW1 solution
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of Solution PW1 to the bead tube.

steps.title: Shake bead tube
steps.instruction: Secure tubes to a rack with tape, secure the rack to a shaker platform, and shake at ≥ 500 rpm for 5 min.

steps.title: Optional low‑speed centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge tubes at ≤ 4 000 × g for 1 min at room temperature (optional if a 15 mL rotor is unavailable).

steps.title: First supernatant transfer
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire supernatant (≈ 600–650 µL) to a clean 2 mL collection tube, ensuring the pipette tip does not touch the beads.

steps.title: High‑speed centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the collection tube at 13 000 × g for 1 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Second supernatant transfer
steps.instruction: Avoid the pellet and transfer the supernatant to a new clean 2 mL collection tube (DNA remains in supernatant).

steps.title: Add IRS solution
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of Solution IRS (15 mL supplied) to the tube, vortex briefly, then incubate on ice for 5 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge after IRS
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13 000 × g for 1 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Third supernatant transfer
steps.instruction: Avoid the pellet and transfer the supernatant to a clean 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Add PW3 solution
steps.instruction: Add 650 µL of Solution PW3, vortex briefly; if PW3 has precipitated, heat at 55 °C for 5–10 min to dissolve.

steps.title: Load onto MB Spin Column
steps.instruction: Load 650 µL of the supernatant onto a MB Spin Column, centrifuge at 13 000 × g for 1 min, discard flow‑through, and repeat until all supernatant is processed.

steps.title: Place column in collection tube
steps.instruction: Insert the MB Spin Column filter into a clean 2 mL collection tube (DNA now bound to the filter).

steps.title: Wash with PW4
steps.instruction: Shake Solution PW4 before use, add 650 µL to the column, centrifuge at 13 000 × g for 1 min, then discard flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 650 µL of ethanol (kit component), centrifuge at 13 000 × g for 1 min, discard flow‑through.

steps.title: Final ethanol wash spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column again at 13 000 × g for 2 min (DNA remains on filter).

steps.title: Elute DNA from column
steps.instruction: Place the column into a clean 2 mL collection tube, add 100 µL of Solution EB (10 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 8.5) to the center of the filter, centrifuge at 13 000 × g for 1 min, discard the column, cap and label the eluate tube (DNA ready for downstream use).

steps.title: Quantify DNA with Qubit
steps.instruction: Prepare working solution (199 µL dsDNA HS Buffer + 1 µL dsDNA HS Reagent per sample). Mix 198 µL working solution with 2 µL each DNA sample in Qubit tubes; also prepare standards (190 µL working solution + 10 µL Standard 1 or 2). Incubate 2 min at room temperature, calibrate the Qubit fluorometer with Standard 1 then 2, read each sample and record concentrations.

steps.title: First PCR – target amplification
steps.instruction: On ice, assemble reaction mix in 0.5 mL LoBind tubes: 12.5 µL OneTaq Hot‑Start 2× Master Mix, 0.5 µL 10 mM Forward Primer, 0.5 µL 10 mM Reverse Primer, 9.5 µL nuclease‑free water, 2 µL template DNA (total 25 µL). Run PCR with the following program (MiniPCR library nanopore_amplicon_barcoding_library.plf/.plfx, protocol “NanoporePCR ampl target”): 94 °C 1 min (1 cycle); 5 cycles of 94 °C 30 s → 60 °C 30 s → 65 °C 50 s per kb; 30 cycles of 94 °C 30 s → 62 °C 30 s → 65 °C 50 s per kb; final extension 65 °C 5 min; cool to RT. Store PCR plate at 4 °C.

steps.title: Second PCR – add barcodes
steps.instruction: On ice, set up 0.5 mL LoBind tubes: 12.5 µL OneTaq Hot‑Start 2× Master Mix, 0.75 µL LWB# Primer mix (barcode), 9.75 µL nuclease‑free water, 2 µL PCR product from Step 1 (total 25 µL). Run PCR using MiniPCR library nanopore_amplicon_barcoding_library.plf/.plfx, protocol “NanoporePCR add barcodes”: 94 °C 1 min (1 cycle); 35 cycles of 94 °C 30 s → 60 °C 30 s → 65 °C 50 s per kb; final extension 65 °C 5 min; cool to RT. Store at 4 °C until clean‑up.

steps.title: Prepare reagents for bead clean‑up
steps.instruction: Make 5 mL of fresh 80 % ethanol in nuclease‑free water (keep on ice). Resuspend AMPure XP beads by vortexing (keep on ice). Prepare 1 500 µL Elution Buffer (10 nM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0 with 50 nM NaCl) by mixing 15 µL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 8.0, 15 µL 5 M NaCl, and 1 470 µL nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Bind DNA to AMPure beads
steps.instruction: Transfer each 25 µL PCR product into a 1.5 mL LoBind tube, add 41 µL resuspended AMPure XP beads (1.8 × reaction volume), flick to mix, and incubate 15 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Separate beads on magnetic rack
steps.instruction: Place tubes on a magnetic rack for 5 min or until the solution is clear; keep tubes on the rack and pipette off the supernatant (DNA > ~200 bp remains bound to beads).

steps.title: Wash beads with ethanol
steps.instruction: While on the magnet, add 200 µL cold 80 % ethanol without disturbing the pellet, incubate 30 s, remove ethanol with a pipette and discard; repeat the wash once more for a total of two washes.

steps.title: Dry beads
steps.instruction: Leave tubes open on the magnetic rack for 5 min to air‑dry.

steps.title: Elute DNA from beads
steps.instruction: Remove tubes from the magnet, resuspend the bead pellet in 40 µL Elution Buffer, flick to mix, incubate 5 min at room temperature, place back on the magnetic rack until eluate is clear (~5 min), then transfer 40 µL eluate to a clean 1.5 mL LoBind tube.

steps.title: Quantify eluted DNA
steps.instruction: Measure concentration of the 40 µL eluate using a Qubit fluorometer (follow the Qubit protocol described earlier).

steps.title: Prepare library for Nanopore sequencing
steps.instruction: On ice, combine up to 12 barcoded DNA samples (from the PCR Barcoding Kit) as follows: transfer 0.5 µL of each sample into a single 0.5 mL PCR tube (or pool equimolar amounts ~50–100 fmol total DNA into 5 µL). Add 0.5 µL RAP, incubate 5 min at room temperature. Prepare Flush Buffer by mixing 117 µL FB with 3 µL FLT (keep on ice). Prepare the library by adding to the 5 µL pooled, RAP‑treated DNA: 13.5 µL SQB and 11 µL LB (mix loading beads by pipetting up/down before measuring). Final library volume = 29.5 µL.

steps.title: Prime the Flongle flowcell
steps.instruction: Open the Flongle loading port by peeling back the tape seal and re‑seal the lid with the tape. Measure 100 µL of the priming buffer (FB/FLT mix) with a P200 pipette, place the tip perpendicular to the port, ensure no bubbles, and slowly dispense the buffer over 5–10 s.

steps.title: Load library onto flowcell
steps.instruction: Gently flick the library tube to mix, measure 29 µL with a P200 pipette, and slowly add the library to the loading port (as with the priming buffer) over 3–5 s. Replace the tape to cover the loading port, seal the MinION lid.
